newsitem.title: UK: NatWest - organic growth unless price right.
newsitem.headline: NatWest - organic growth unless price right.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc will grow its long-term savings and investments business organically unless it can find acquisitions at a suitable price, its chief executive Derek Wanless said on Tuesday.
Wanless told reporters at a press briefing that the bank saw good growth in investment products in the coming years but would not make acquisitions unless they add value for shareholders.
"it may be that we'll have to do it organically or it may be that the market changes and prices drop," Wanless said.
Earlier, he told Reuters that NatWest had decided not to enter the bidding war for mutually-owned life assurer Scottish Amicable because the likely price could not be justified.
NatWest chairman Lord Alexander said at the press briefing that the business could grow oprganically but that growth would be accelerated if a suitable acquisition came along.
Wanless said NatWest had signed a confidentiality agreement with ScotAm recently and, after seeing the figures, had informed ScotAm on Monday that it was not interested in pursuing the matter.
